result_semantic_payload.summary: The 'windows' scope actually contains no Windows-derived artifacts: get_task_context reports platforms=[] and source_scopes=[], and the only captured material is 4 plain-text files (no registry, event-log, prefetch, amcache, or account/IP data). Evidence of a payment-collection operation is limited to two files. (1) /data/收款记录.txt is a payment-record ledger with three dated USDT receipts totalling 99,500 USDT: 2023-11-02 陈某 30,000 to bank card 6222020212345678901; 2023-11-04 周某 17,500 to wallet 0xDEAD1111; 2023-11-09 吴某 52,000 to wallet 0xDEAD1111. (2) /platform/说明.txt is an internal platform-operation note identifying the platform as 聚宝盆, admin URL http://jbpenl-admin.example, and a daily new-user recruitment target of 20 per customer-service group. The README.txt documents the intended evidentiary partition: data/ holds payment records, platform/ holds platform operation notes, and personal/ holds the owner's private documents with no evidential relation to the payment operation and which must not be cited as evidence of it. Accordingly, /personal/体检报告.txt (a 2023-10-20 medical examination report for 陈某, noting normal blood pressure and elevated lipids, itself stating it is unrelated to any fund activity) must be kept out of the payment-collection evidentiary chain. Note that 陈某 appears in both the medical report and the payment ledger; the name overlap is a person identifier, not a link between the two documents, and the medical report remains inadmissible as payment evidence. Temporal corroboration is absent: all four files share a single mtime/ctime (epoch 1790594136) and a single CREATED cluster, so no independent creation sequence or account/execution corroboration exists.

claim_candidates.text: The device holds a payment-record ledger at /data/收款记录.txt containing three dated USDT receipts totalling 99,500 USDT: 2023-11-02 陈某 30,000 USDT to bank card 6222020212345678901; 2023-11-04 周某 17,500 USDT to wallet 0xDEAD1111; 2023-11-09 吴某 52,000 USDT to wallet 0xDEAD1111.

The device holds an internal platform-operation note at /platform/说明.txt naming the platform 聚宝盆, giving the back-office address http://jbpenl-admin.example, and setting a daily new-user recruitment target of 20 persons per customer-service group.

The README.txt states that /data/ holds payment records, /platform/ holds platform operation notes, and /personal/ holds the owner's private documents that have no evidential relation to the payment operation and must not be cited as evidence of it.

The document that must stay out of the payment-collection evidentiary chain is /personal/体检报告.txt, a 2023-10-20 medical examination report for 陈某 (normal blood pressure, elevated lipids, recheck advised) that itself states it is unrelated to any fund activity.

Although 陈某 appears both in the medical report and in the payment ledger, the name overlap is only a person identifier and does not make the medical report evidence of the payment operation; it remains excluded from the payment evidentiary chain.
limitations: No content in either document links the medical record to the USDT receipts; the exclusion rests on the README's stated partition plus the report's own self-description.

claim_candidates.text: No independent temporal or behavioural corroboration of the payment operation exists in this scope: all four files share one mtime/ctime (epoch 1790594136) and belong to a single CREATED cluster, and no Windows account, logon, prefetch or amcache data was captured.
limitations: Absence of corroboration reflects parser/capture coverage, not proof that such artifacts do not exist on the original device.

The 'windows' source scope returned no platform scenario and no registered source scope; no registry, event-log, prefetch, amcache, account or source-IP data was available, so account-usage and execution corroboration of the payment operation could not be attempted.
All four captured files share a single mtime/ctime and a single CREATED cluster; timestamps therefore cannot corroborate when the payment records were actually produced.
File md5 values are empty in the file listing, so no hash-based integrity assertion is made for the cited files.
The 99,500 USDT total is the arithmetic sum of the three ledger lines; no external ledger, chain, or bank record was available to confirm the receipts.

Provenance of README.txt (investigator note vs. on-device document) is undetermined, so its directory-partition statement is used as a triage rule rather than as independent subject-authored evidence.
The medical report's exclusion is grounded in the README's stated partition plus the document's own self-description; no forensic test of relevance was possible beyond content review.
warnings: The delegated scope 'windows' is a mislabel: no Windows artifacts exist in this task; the findings are based entirely on four plain-text files.
The name 陈某 appears in both the excluded medical report and the in-chain payment ledger; do not let that shared identifier pull the medical report into the payment evidentiary chain.
